ALSA: hda/realtek: Add quirks for some Clevo laptops

Add the audio quirk for some of Clevo's latest RPL laptops:

- NP50RNJS (ALC256)
- NP70SNE (ALC256)
- PD50SNE (ALC1220)
- PE60RNE (ALC1220)
